messages:
marta: Heads up — noticed ~50 auth failures in /v1/generate over a 6m window after last deploy. Only path affected is our public chat route.
jamal: saw that. Logs show 401s with error 'token_expired' but tokens should be valid until TTL=3600.
marta: attaching sample log: ```[2026-03-22T18:12:34Z] req_id=abc123 user_id=svc-frontend status=401 detail=token_expired token_ttl=3600 token_age=4200```
lina: token_age > ttl — suggests clock skew or double-issuing tokens. Also seen in last 3 incident summaries (noticeable pattern).
alex: quick question: do we have authoritative TTL source? config-service vs env var? I think config-service override was rolled out last week.
jamal: confirmed: config-service has ttl=3600, but a hotfix on frontend sets env REDWOOD_TOKEN_TTL=3000. mismatch.
lina: oof. root cause likely config drift from staged canary merge.
marta: proposed actions:
• A1: canonicalize TTL — config-service wins and remove env override. Owner: jamal. Due: 2026-03-25 EOD. Acceptance: no env overrides present in infra manifests.
• A2: add token-validation canary endpoint + alert on >1% 401 spike. Owner: alex. Due: 2026-03-27. Acceptance: metric + dashboard + pager rule.
• A3: add audit log field request_token_ttl and store in s3 index for 30d. Owner: lina. Due: 2026-04-02.
• A4: rotate service-secret for frontend (force short TTL) + notify customers using dedicated capacity. Owner: ops-oncall. Due: 2026-03-29.
• A5: run retro-run across last 6 incidents to detect drift patterns and add to recurring postmortem board. Owner: marta. Due: 2026-03-31.
jamal: I'll open the PR to remove env override now.
ops-oncall: starting secret rotation job tonight at 02:00 UTC, will post update.
security-bot: Reminder: rotate-stale-secrets job created — run-id=rot-279123.
alex: for A2 I'll prototype canary on staging and push dashboards.
lina: audit schema change needs migration plan — I'll sync with data infra.
marta: thanks. tagging @eng-sre for mute window plan and rollout order.
eng-sre: we'll coordinate the canary rollout and suppress flapping alerts during rotation window.
alex: adding checklists to the PR: config change, canary test, dashboard, alert.
marta: Can everyone add status updates to this thread when they start and when done? I'll track ownership in the remediation board.
lina: starting A3 — ETA 2 days.
jamal: A1 done — PR merged, manifest updated. rolling out canary now.
ops-oncall: A4 rotation complete — new secret TTL enforced. No 401 spikes since 02:15 UTC. :tada:
marta: closing note: Schedule a monthly audit of token configs across services to prevent drift. Proposed owner: security. Any objections?
security: fine by me, will set recurring calendar and runbook.
marta: thanks all — adding action items to postmortem tracker and linking the incident. /end
